systems.owner: Ministry of Education (AFAP procuring, World Bank-financed project)

note: Tender notice for technical assistance to implement the SIGE school-management system; it describes no link between education systems, and SIGE is a school-management system on its own, class other.

systems.owner: Ministry of Education, Science and Culture

note: Launch of SIGE as a single school-management database (library, statistics, secretariat, parts of finance); it states no exchange with another education system, so class other and no fact.

systems.system: Dashboards para a supervisão educativa nacional

note: A UNICEF tender for university-built supervision dashboards, proposals due 2026-05-14; it states no link or data exchange between education systems.

facts.fact: The GPE partnership compact, endorsed by the local education partners group, lists as a constraint the lack of articulation between the elements of the Ministry of Education's information system, so teacher access, workload and history data and school-materials requests cannot be fed or matched with SIGE data.

systems.system: Sistema Integrado de Gestão Escolar (SIGE / EMIS)
systems.owner: Ministério da Educação, Cultura e Ciências (MECC), with the World Bank

systems.system: Passaporte para a aprendizagem (national digital learning platform)

note: The compact says MECC and the World Bank are developing the EMIS/SIGE to link information between the central level and the districts; that is one system's tiers, not a link between education systems, so no underway fact.

systems.platform: online platform connecting schools to DPEI
systems.owner: Ministry of Education, Directorate of Planning and Education Innovation (DPEI)

note: The ICR (2019) describes the national EMIS (SIGE) as a school-to-ministry data-capture system and states no link, exchange or shared learner identifier with the examinations body, payroll, learner registration or national ID; EMIS alone is class other.
School-attendance verification with the Ministry of Education is a social protection link, and its monitoring module is listed for phase 3.
The document states nothing this study asks.
The notice states no data link between education systems.
